title: Sundance Canyon eBike and Hike Guided Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Clients must feel comfortable riding a bike
Clients are required to have clothing appropriate for weather conditions on the day
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: A perfect combination of moderate hiking and ebiking for families and first timers departing right from downtown Banff. See Banff highlights, cycle along Bow River pathway and enjoy a short but challenging guided hike following the waters of secluded Sundance Canyon, away from the crowds of Banff.
